title: FrankyDocs
tagline: Multi-chain crypto treasury and gasless trading agent, native to Google Docs.
description:
*FrankyDocs* is an autonomous multi-chain treasury and trading agent
embedded directly within Google Docs.
Description

A Docs crypto operating system that enables institutional-grade treasury
management without browser extensions. FrankyDocs uses Google Docs as a
collaborative interface to manage cross-chain assets across *Sui*, *Arc*,
and *Yellow Network*.
Key Features

- *Google Docs Workspace*: Operations, trading, and auditing occur
entirely within document tables.
- *DeepBook Integration (Sui)*: Automated market/limit trading, price
monitoring, and conditional orders (Stop-Loss/Take-Profit).
- *Circle & CCTP (Arc)*: Managed USDC payouts and cross-chain bridging
without manual wallet signatures.
- *Yellow Network*: Gasless, instant off-chain payments and atomic swaps
via state channels.
-

*Autonomous Agent*: Real-time monitoring for low gas, idle capital, and
volatility, with auto-proposals for rebalancing and DCA.

- *Unified Treasury*: Real-time valuation and distribution tracking
across all integrated chains and managed accounts.
how_its_made:
Proposers type DW <command> in a Google Doc — no wallet needed
Agent discovers the Doc, parses commands, validates quorum
Approvers sign via MetaMask on the web UI → approval stored on Yellow state channel (gasless)
Quorum met → Agent auto-executes the command on the target chain
Results written back to the Google Doc (Commands table, Audit Log, Recent Activity)
